title: The Solar Path
author: Tuhinamshu Rath
text:
Ask me not how I am
The way I am here, I am well.
My vision is lost indeed
But my dreams are alive still.
My fingers are severed though
My right is never lost.
My feet can no more tread
True, but the road is not ambushed
My dear earth and I
Self-same we alive together
Like drops of dew thriving
Transiently on the edges of leaves
We live in love, promises and perfectness.
Earthquakes do occur.
Is house-building abandoned? Storms do despoil
Does Buddha`s smile Vanish from his lips?

Everyday our dear Earth and I
Undergo a change alike.
We fling all our incompetence
To the darkling past
And transform the present
In to solar path of competence.

Whether we exist or not
Means nothing in life.
Life means the solar path indeed.
Neither anguish nor despair
Can eliminate our dreams.
Neither scarcity nor vengeance
Can ever suppress our right
Neither pretence nor pain
Can beguile our journey.

Neither agony nor woe
Can ever kill
The dream of creativity
Even in the midst of dissolution.
Our dear earth and I
Have right to the self defence
Against fierce fire.

Yes, our dear Earth and I.
We make our flaming journey
even in the midst of inertia.

So long our dear Earth
is lodged within me
Let me live well
no matter
How would life place me.

Translated by: Prof. Raj kishore Mishra
